notes.title: Happy Furry Restaurant Patch (1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Hello, we're excited to announce a new update for Happy Furry Restaurant.

[list]
[*] Added a tutorial for the whipping machine attached to the waiter.
[*] Fixed some issues with the Korean translation.
[*] Made some adjustments to the modeling on the final day.
[/list]

We have received some reports from players about bugs and optimization issues on the final day. Our restaurant team is aware of these issues and is working to resolve the technical problems and deploy a fix. Thank you for your patience.
